name: Elden Ring
description: Rise, Tarnished, and explore the Lands Between in FromSoftware's open-world action RPG. Face punishing bosses, discover hidden dungeons and build your character your way.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Ride with Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang as the age of outlaws comes to an end. A vast, living open world set in 1899 America.

name: Split Fiction
description: A co-op adventure from the makers of It Takes Two. Two writers are trapped in their own stories and must work together across sci-fi and fantasy worlds to escape.

name: FIFA 23
description: The final FIFA title from EA Sports, with HyperMotion2 technology, men's and women's World Cups and cross-play in Ultimate Team.

name: Cyberpunk 2077
description: An open-world action RPG set in Night City, a megalopolis obsessed with power and body modification. Play as V, a mercenary chasing a one-of-a-kind implant.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: Geralt of Rivia searches for his adopted daughter in a war-torn open world. Monster contracts, branching quests and two acclaimed expansions await.

name: Baldur's Gate 3
description: Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms in Larian's party-based RPG built on Dungeons & Dragons 5th edition rules.

name: Hogwarts Legacy
description: Live the life of a fifth-year student at Hogwarts in the 1800s. Learn spells, brew potions and uncover an ancient magic hidden in the wizarding world.

name: Grand Theft Auto V
description: Three very different criminals plan a series of daring heists in the sprawling city of Los Santos. Includes access to GTA Online.

name: Minecraft: Java & Bedrock Edition
description: Build, mine and survive in an endless world of blocks. Both PC editions in one package, with cross-play on Bedrock.

name: Counter-Strike 2 Prime Status
description: Upgrade to Prime in Counter-Strike 2 for matchmaking with other Prime players, exclusive drops and ranked competitive play.

name: Stardew Valley
description: Inherit your grandfather's old farm and turn overgrown fields into a thriving home. Farm, fish, mine and befriend the locals of Pelican Town.

name: Hades II
description: Battle beyond the Underworld as Melinoe, Princess of the Underworld, in Supergiant's sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

name: Sea of Thieves
description: Set sail with friends in a shared-world pirate adventure. Hunt treasure, fight skeletons and battle other crews on the open sea.

name: God of War Ragnarok
description: Kratos and Atreus journey through the Nine Realms as Fimbulwinter draws to a close and Ragnarok approaches.

name: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
description: Peter Parker and Miles Morales team up against Kraven and the Venom symbiote in an expanded open-world New York.

name: Astro Bot
description: Rescue the crew across more than 50 planets in a joyful 3D platformer built to show off the DualSense controller.

name: Gran Turismo 7
description: The real driving simulator returns with hundreds of cars, legendary tracks and a single-player campaign celebrating car culture.

name: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
description: Cloud and his friends leave Midgar behind in the second part of the Final Fantasy VII remake trilogy, set in a vast open world.

name: EA Sports FC 25
description: Play the world's game with FC IQ tactics, Rush 5v5 mode and over 19,000 licensed players across 700 teams.

name: Starfield
description: Bethesda's first new universe in 25 years. Create a character and explore more than a thousand planets as a member of Constellation.

name: Forza Horizon 5
description: Explore the vibrant landscapes of Mexico in hundreds of the world's greatest cars in the best-selling open-world racing series.

name: Halo Infinite
description: Master Chief returns to face the Banished on the ring world Zeta Halo, with a free-to-play multiplayer experience included.

name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
description: Uncover one of history's greatest mysteries as Indiana Jones in a first-person adventure set between Raiders of the Lost Ark and The Last Crusade.

name: Diablo IV
description: Lilith has returned to Sanctuary. Fight endless hordes of demons, collect legendary loot and explore a shared open world.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
description: Link's adventure expands to the skies above Hyrule. Combine objects with new abilities to build vehicles, weapons and solutions.

name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
description: Race your friends or battle them in the definitive version of Mario Kart 8, with every track and character from the Wii U original.

name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
description: Escape to a deserted island and create your own paradise. Gather resources, craft furniture and welcome animal neighbours.

name: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
description: Classic side-scrolling Mario gets a wild twist: touch a Wonder Flower and the level transforms in surprising ways.

name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Play as Hornet, princess-protector of Hallownest, and climb a haunted kingdom of silk and song in this action platformer.
